rules.content:
/*
DragonForce ransomware
*/

rule DragonForce_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.dragonforce"
        description = "Detects DragonForce ransomware ransom note"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $s1 = "DragonForce" ascii nocase
        $s2 = "DragonForce_README.txt" ascii nocase
        $s3 = ".DragonForce" ascii
        $s4 = "dragonforce.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
